mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM got_point WHERE deleted = 0) AS totalPoint, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM got_record WHERE DATE(check_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayCheck, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM got_user WHERE status=1 AND role=2 AND deleted=0) AS normalUser, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM got_point WHERE deleted = 0 ) - ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT point_id) FROM got_record WHERE DATE(check_time) = CURDATE() ) AS abnormalCount
SELECT DATE(check_time) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM got_record WHERE DATE(check_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 29 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(check_time) ORDER BY dt ASC
